impact: Base64 inflates WOFF2 by ~4/3, and subsetting can shrink it 5-10x. Users can't currently tell what a font is actually costing them in the output SVG. Show pre/post/subset sizes in the font row so the tradeoff is visible.
resolution: Committed in 40c194a. Added one always-emitted summary line to the report after the existing subset totals: `Embedded: N KB font · ~M KB base64 payload in SVG`. Computed as `subsettedFonts.reduce((a,f) => a + f.base64.length, 0)` so the figure reflects exactly what embedFontFaces() will inline. Per-face raw bytes and per-face subset info remain (line 613, upload rows) — this closes the gap by showing the aggregate figure that matches the shipped SVG size.
title: Show final embedded size next to raw font weight
